component.name: Rattonero Books
component.summary: Read the EPUB and PDF books in a folder of your own

description.p: Rattonero Books shows every EPUB and PDF in a folder you pick, on shelves ordered by author, title, publisher or year the way a library would. Books are paginated like printed pages, with a choice of theme, text size, margins and line spacing.
Your books are never changed. Reading progress is kept in a small hidden folder beside them, so when the folder is shared between your computers and phones, each one picks up where you left off.
Book files are treated as untrusted: they are parsed in safe Rust, cleaned of scripts and forms, and shown without any network access.
